decisions.reason: Although still prominently shown, an accelerator program is relatively far from this growing machinery-and-recycling firm's core revenue model and is the most likely offer to be discontinued if management reallocates resources to core technology and R&D.

Despite being less directly aligned with the firm's machinery base, it is presented as a flagship and maintained on its own page across both years, suggesting management still sees strategic value in it as a circular-economy growth area.

This decontamination plant is close to the established offer, repeatedly highlighted on the home page as a focal product, and fits the firm's decentralized waste-treatment strategy, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
